description: Na₆B₄Sn₂SO₁₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fd̅3 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SnO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-84°. There are two shorter (2.40 Å) and four longer (2.49 Å) Na-O bond lengths. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. Sn is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SnO₆ octahedra that share edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All Sn-O bond lengths are 2.09 Å. S is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All S-O bond lengths are 1.50 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one B, and one Sn atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and one S atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃S trigonal pyramids.
